recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If implementers need role-specific preferences, that should be a new PA decision rather than further FHIR-22114 reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA issue requesting Practitioner.communication consistency with Patient and RelatedPerson communication, specifically preserving the distinction between languages a practitioner can use and a preferred language.
initial_application: No separate source commit was tagged FHIR-22114. The FHIR-22114 resolution says FHIR-26654 updates address the request, and the explicit FHIR-26654 commit f0398618a026c4fc3381d09fe7690c7b73fa9d6b added the current Practitioner.communication backbone and preferred child.
additional_context: FHIR-26654 is the applied same-change-family decision. FHIR-54008 later confirmed no PractitionerRole.communication.preferred child should be added, and FHIR-41524 later corrected language-tag wording without altering the preference structure.
reconciliation: No source edits were made. The active Practitioner StructureDefinition already satisfies the requested consistency, and later context supports leaving PractitionerRole as a role/service language list.
